svg.title: Reports across teams, matching fields by key — SoftTrack web design mockup (#332)
svg.desc: A report can take several teams the reader can read. Built-in properties group across them as they are and statuses by category; a team’s own field groups across teams only when every chosen team has a field with the same key and kind, and an option only one team has stays its own group. Numbers never come from a team the reader cannot see.

svg.text: Done when a report takes several teams the reader can read, as a member or organisation viewer; when statuses group by category across teams; when a field is offered across
teams only when every chosen team has its key with the same kind, options match by id and unmatched options stay labelled with their team; when the Fields page says which
other teams share a key; when cross-team reports are private; and when a reader who left a team sees the rest and a line saying so.
